question: As per Census of India 2011, which state has the highest percentage of Scheduled Tribe population to total Scheduled Tribe population in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** has the highest Scheduled Tribe population (14.7 per cent).
 
• **Madhya Pradesh **is one of the **most populated states in India and has the highest tribal population in the country touching a galloping number of 15.31 million and covering 21.1% of the state's population.**
 
• Spread across **705 tribes**, they account for** ****8.6% of the country's total population. **
 
• There are **46** **recognized Scheduled Tribes in Madhya Pradesh**, India, three of which have been identified as '**Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PTGs)(formerly known as 'Special Primitive Tribal Groups').**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are **thirty-one** **(31) notified Scheduled Tribes in the state Gujrat**, which are as follows:** 1 Kharadi. 2 Balat. 4 Bhil, Bhil Taviyad, Bhil Garasia, Dholi Bhil, Dungri Bhil, Dungri Garasia, Mewasi Bhil, Malivad bhil, Rawal Bhil, Tadvi Bhil, Bhagalia, Bhilala, Pawra, Valvi, Vasava, Vasave, Katara, Bhabhor.**
 
• The tribes of** Jharkhand consist of** **32** tribes inhabiting the Jharkhand state in India. 
 
• **Gond tribes** have the largest population in **Chhattisgarh.**
